title: Arcade Hall of Fame
description: Ranks the players of a Polyglot Arcade game by their best round, or names the champion of every game.

title.title: Title
title.description: Hall of Fame, or Hall of Fame · <game>

periodLabel.title: Period
periodLabel.description: Today, This week, This month or All time

rounds.title: Rounds
rounds.description: Rounds played in the period, lost rounds included

players.title: Players
players.description: Players who played in the period

allGames.title: All Games
allGames.description: True when the entries are the champions of every game

hasEntries.title: Has Entries
hasEntries.description: True when at least one player scored

message.title: Message
message.description: Shown instead of the ranking, for example when no one scored yet

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Rank, player, game, best score and rounds
